pattern: the task needs what a private document says
experience: The owner asks for a fact that is only in a private document. The agent asks to open that one document, by name, and says why, instead of searching the disk or asking the owner to paste it.
rule: request_private_document: Only when the task truly needs what the document says. `reason` is shown to the owner.
